resources.string: Choose an effects budget. Wallpaper resolution is independent and stays unchanged.
Static wallpaper, plain controls and no focus tilt; lighter, faster focus animation.
Dynamic wallpaper and regular glass allowed; moderate focus scale and tilt; extreme glass paused.
Larger focus scale and tilt; dynamic wallpaper and extreme glass allowed, following your saved switches.
Your style choice is saved. Smooth uses plain controls and disables tilt; other profiles follow the selected style.
Available in Full effects. This switch preserves your own choice.
Paused by this profile. Open the profile list to choose Full effects; your glass switch stays saved.
Reset only the performance profile, Dock columns, clock style, focus, glass and Top Shelf presentation. Keep apps, folders, uploads, wallpaper and quality, screensaver, network and permissions.
Choose recommendations or wallpaper for apps with a configured source. Feeds are public recommendations; unavailable feeds leave your wallpaper visible.
Off pauses automatic changes and keeps the current available recommendation still.
No installed apps have a configured recommendation source.
Local focus and glass budget sample; saved style switches still apply.
